about_the_game:
A casual incremental game with a complete story set in prohibition-era New York City.

Key Features:

  • 20 rackets with unique upgrade paths and owner stories

  • Over 5,000 words of character dialogue

  • 10 ascension levels with narrative cutscenes

  • Hitman battles with multiple weapon tiers

  • 15 permanent upgrades across three skill trees

  • Complete story with multiple endings based on your choices

  • Idle progression with optional automation

---

You start with nothing but ambition and a few dollars in your pocket. Your first break comes when a local boss takes notice of your potential and offers you a chance to prove yourself. What begins as small-time work quickly grows into something much bigger.

Build Your Criminal Network

Invest in 20 different illegal operations across the city. Run speakeasies where the booze flows freely, operate gambling halls where fortunes change hands nightly, and control protection rackets that keep businesses "safe."

From Mae's underground speakeasy to Mickey's smuggling operation at the docks, you'll meet dozens of colorful characters. Unlock their personal backstories with Influence to gain permanent bonuses and learn what drives them.

Ascend the Hierarchy

When you've built your empire as far as it can go, it's time to Ascend. Reset your operations but keep your reputation, earning Notoriety that unlocks powerful permanent upgrades in the Ascension Market.

After each ascension, Don Salvatore Russo checks in to give you his assessment. Are you building a lasting legacy or leaving a trail of mistakes? Your choices throughout determine his verdict and your ultimate fate.

Choose your path through three skill trees:

- Composure - Automate your operations and spot the best opportunities

- Connections - Build your network and keep your fortune safe

- Capo - Master the art of professional violence

Fight for Rival Hitmen

When diplomacy fails, bullets fly. Starting at Ascension 1, face off against rival hitmen in shootouts. Upgrade your arsenal from a Colt 1911 pistol to the legendary Thompson machine gun.

A Complete Story

This isn't an endless grind. Your criminal career has a beginning, middle, and end. Experience a complete narrative across 10 ascension levels as you rise from nobody to the ultimate crime lord. Your choices determine your fate - will you build a lasting legacy or leave a trail of betrayal?

The city is waiting. How far will you go to rule it all?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: A casual, story-driven incremental game set in 1920s New York. Build your criminal empire from speakeasies to protection rackets, fight rival hitmen, meet colorful characters, and become the city's most powerful crime lord.
